subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should CodexBar collect detailed account-wide Cursor usage-event history through existing cookie-authenticated sessions, or require a dedicated explicit opt-in before enabling this cost report?
rationale: Tests cannot determine whether the existing cost-summary toggle and Cursor authentication selection constitute sufficient user consent for a new private-endpoint history fetch; the repository owner explicitly reserved this product/privacy choice.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a dedicated consent setting with clear account-wide remote-source, privacy, endpoint-stability, and estimate wording before any usage-event request.

options.title: Reuse existing consent
options.body: Treat enabling cost summaries while Cursor is enabled as sufficient consent, but document that decision explicitly and prove every credential-source path.

options.title: Keep Cursor summary-only
options.body: Do not add detailed Cursor usage-event collection if the private endpoint or expanded authentication boundary is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated consent setting with clear account-wide remote-source, privacy, endpoint-stability, and estimate wording before any usage-event request.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner explicitly placed the PR on hold and framed the exact product/privacy decision required for landing.
